children: Founder of The LSM Group to support KALA's growth across its existing business and potential acquisitions
NEW YORK, Sept. 17, 2026
-- KALA BIO, Inc.

("KALA" or the "Company") today announced that Yenvy Truong, founder of The LSM Group, has joined the Company's advisory team. Ms. Truong will support management as KALA grows its existing business and evaluates opportunities to expand it, including through acquisitions.

Ms. Truong has spent roughly two decades in healthcare operations, including building and operating diagnostic laboratories. She has founded, scaled, and advised healthcare and life sciences companies across genomics, longevity, remote patient monitoring, digital musculoskeletal care, and metabolic medicine, through mergers, acquisitions, and growth financings totaling more than $200 million in transaction and enterprise value.

KALA is focused on expanding its business in diagnostics, genetic testing, and other areas of preventive and connected health, all enhanced by AI. That growth may come from the Company's existing business, commercial agreements such as its exclusive distribution and reseller agreement with Virotek Inc., new services, and acquisitions. The Company believes Ms. Truong's operating experience and industry relationships will provide it with insight into opportunities that align with those goals.

"Our focus is growth, starting with the business and agreements we already have," said Avi Minkowitz, Chief Executive Officer of KALA. "Acquisitions can add to that, but only when they fit. Yenvy has built and run diagnostics and biotech/healthcare businesses and understands what it takes to scale them. She gives us a clearer view of where the right opportunities are, whether that is a new service, a new partner, or a company we bring into KALA."

"KALA has a clear plan to grow its business and to expand where it makes sense. I'm looking forward to working with Avi and the team to identify opportunities that fit that plan and to help build long-term value," said Ms. Truong.
Ms. Truong serves as an advisor to the Company and is neither an officer nor an employee of KALA.
About Kala Bio, Inc.

KALA BIO, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company building a dedicated, on-premises AI infrastructure platform for the biotechnology industry. The Company's dual strategy combines a proprietary biologics pipeline—including its mesenchymal stem cell secretome (MSC-S) platform and FDA Orphan Drug- and Fast Track-designated product candidates—with a scalable AI platform-as-a-service business designed to deploy secure, purpose-built AI solutions directly within biotech and pharmaceutical client environments.

Through its exclusive worldwide license for the Researgency AI research platform from Younet, Kala intends to serve as the dedicated AI infrastructure partner for the biotechnology industry, enabling organizations of all sizes to unlock the value of their proprietary biological data without surrendering control. Kala is advancing an agentic transformation strategy for biomedical organizations through Researgency.ai, a platform designed to enable scalable, governed deployment of AI agents across research, documentation, and operational workflows. The Company's focus on enterprise security, real-time performance, and seamless integration positions it at the forefront of innovation in the life sciences AI sector.
Kala believes the future of biomedical innovation is in agentic systems.

About The LSM Group

The LSM Group is a healthcare advisory firm working at the intersection of healthcare, life sciences, AI, and capital strategy. Founded by Yenvy Truong, the firm advises investors and operators on diagnostics, specialty pharmaceutical assets, applied AI in regulated environments, and longevity, and maintains a domain expert panel that evaluates companies before capital is committed.
